reason: Material change and renewal are now explicit lifecycle decisions.

required_change: Replace any aggregate completeness score as the primary output with a provenance audit: missing authoritative records, stale evidence, unresolved triggers, conflicting versions, absent authority and overdue review.
reason: The revised book emphasizes integration without aggregation and non-compensatory safeguards.

required_change: Replace the remote diagnostic pathway principal case with an AI-assisted remote diagnostic pathway. Preserve the former case only as an archived optional variant.
reason: The applied case in the revised book has changed.

required_change: Add reconciled economic/environmental boundaries, common functional unit, average versus marginal consequences, monetisation status, residual value, resilience, double-counting controls, incomplete-monetisation display, rebound and burden transfer.
reason: These are central analytical distinctions in the revised chapter.

required_change: Add eligibility-before-economics, supported service life, forms of obsolescence, dependency bottlenecks, equivalent annual cost, realizable residual value, decision thresholds and closure conditions.
reason: The revised asset-life analysis is materially more rigorous.

required_change: Separate economic cost, cash expenditure and accounting expense; identify budget incidence; distinguish observed change from financially recognized benefit; add NPV, ROI, payback, downside scenarios and renewal/exit.
reason: The financial chapter now distinguishes value, budget and accounting effects.

required_change: Add explicit AI model characteristics, uncertainty categories, threshold analysis, EVPI, EVPPI where supported, EVSI, ENBS, research cost, and a research-design recommendation.
reason: The revised chapter gives greater prominence to value of information and research design.

required_change: Add continuing supplier disclosure, version-matched claims, upstream dependencies, audit rights, obligation register, post-award escalation and renewal as a new commercial decision.
reason: Procurement governance now extends beyond award.

required_change: For each analysis, state the evidentiary claim, suitable design, result, assumptions, what can be established and what remains unresolved. Add estimand and re-evaluation trigger fields.
reason: The revised chapter separates predictive validity, decision utility and causal effect.

required_change: Add stocks, inflows, outflows, inner/outer loops, circular leakage, functional units, resource intensity, rebound, induced demand, spatial burden and distributional consequences.
reason: The revised chapter expands resource accounting and burden shifting.

required_change: Add task denominator, gross and net labour saving, quality adjustment, fragmentation, bottleneck, downstream workload, capacity usability, capacity destination, work intensity and persistence.
reason: The revised productivity logic is service-level rather than task-time alone.

required_change: Link every monitoring signal to an owner, triage decision, escalation time, investigation, CAPA, effectiveness check, closure authority and institutional-learning action.
reason: The revised chapter makes closure dependent on evidence of effectiveness.

required_change: Add residual-risk authority, answerability, contestability, assurance independence, conflict declarations, dissent, patient/public communication, reauthorization and legitimacy evidence.
reason: The governance chapter is now more explicitly institutional and authority-centred.

required_change: Represent the sequence from context and evidence through AI signal, human interpretation, decision right, action, outcome and feedback. Add signal, interpretation and action latency.
reason: The new chapter architecture differs from the old delegation/dashboard split.

required_change: Replace generic maturity conclusions with a use-case readiness decision, critical dependency register, remediation decision, pilot-appropriate uncertainty, and conditions that make deployment premature.
reason: The revised chapter rejects readiness as a permanent institutional label.

required_change: Update terminology to complete intervention, realistic comparator, option value, reversible adoption and integrated decision conditions. Remove references to old Tables 1.4–1.6 and Figure 1.4.
reason: The revised chapter consolidates introductory instruments.

required_change: Add efficiency-frontier reporting, threshold-specific NMB, transferability, annual and cumulative budget impact, budget-holder timing, distribution, HTA translation and local adoption decision.
reason: The revised chapter sharpens the distinction among economic and institutional decisions.
